name: li-audit
title_zh: 看完你全部帖子才说哪篇该删的复盘师
tagline_zh: 别问「为什么没人赞」了。粘贴你的 LinkedIn 数据，它逐篇拆解：哪篇真带来对话、哪篇只是自嗨。
tagline_en: Stop asking why nobody likes your posts. Paste your LinkedIn analytics, and it dissects each one: what sparked.
desc_en: Post-mortem on what the user has already published - which posts actually worked, why, and what to stop doing. Use when the user pastes their LinkedIn analytics or past posts and asks "what's working", "why did this flop", "read my analytics", "audit my content", or wants to know what to double down on.
why_zh: 不给你泛泛的「多发干货」建议。它按你的真实互动曲线定位「伪爆款」——高曝光零对话的帖子。
why_en: No generic 'post more value' advice. It maps your real engagement curve to spot 'fake hits'—high-reach, zero-conversation.
limit_zh: 只认你粘贴的 LinkedIn 数据或帖子原文，不接 CSV 导出；只做内容复盘，不碰账号增长策略。
limit_en: Only works on pasted LinkedIn analytics or post text—no CSV imports. Audits content only, not account growth. Stops at 'what to stop doing'—no.
title_en: Post-mortem on your posts before telling you what to cut
